title: Aeroponic Garden Setup in Tahiti Countryside
reason: The video discusses an aeroponic farm setup in Tahiti and highlights local crop cultivation.

tasks.task: Describe the setting and crops being grown.

subtasks.text: Observe the aeroponic tower farm being set up in the countryside of Tahiti.

frames.caption: A woman is standing on a ladder next to a series of white towers in a grassy area.
A couple stands on a wooden platform with their arms outstretched, overlooking a scenic coastal landscape.
A line of white vertical towers with green bases stand on a grassy lawn.

subtasks.text: Note the diverse crops including leafy greens, herbs like cilantro and parsley, and vegetables such as buck choy.

frames.caption: A person is harvesting lettuce from a vertical garden.
A person is harvesting a large bok choy from a hydroponic system.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of local farming on isolated islands.

subtasks.text: Highlight how growing vegetables locally on an island like Tahiti reduces dependency on imported produce.

frames.caption: A lush, green cilantro plant grows vertically in a container.
A group of white vertical towers with green bases and holes in the sides are set up outdoors.
